class.name: OcgGraphic3dBSDF
class.brief_description: Describes material's BSDF (Bidirectional Scattering Distribution Function) used for physically-based rendering (in path tracing engine). BSDF is represented as weighted mixture of basic BRDFs/BTDFs (Bidirectional Reflectance (Transmittance) Distribution Functions).
class.description: ! Describes material's BSDF (Bidirectional Scattering Distribution Function) used ! for physically-based rendering (in path tracing engine). BSDF is represented as ! weighted mixture of basic BRDFs/BTDFs (Bidirectional Reflectance (Transmittance) ! Distribution Functions). ! ! NOTE: OCCT uses two-layer material model. We have base diffuse, glossy, or transmissive ! layer, covered by one glossy/specular coat. In the current model, the layers themselves ! have no thickness; they can simply reflect light or transmits it to the layer under it. ! We use actual BRDF model only for direct reflection by the coat layer. For transmission ! through this layer, we approximate it as a flat specular surface.
